name: KilledByAPixel/LittleJSArcade
embed_notes: Every game is ONE self-contained .html file (games/*.html) served from GitHub Pages; drop into an iframe with zero build. Portal shell (arcade.css, games.js, attract-mode demos, saved high scores) is itself an open-source arcade portal you can copy.
reskin_notes: Games draw with LittleJS tile/emoji rendering (Twemoji font) and small inline sprite data; no external atlas, so mascot swap = replace the tileImage/emoji glyph + palette constants inside the single file. Very few art assets to redraw. Top-of-list candidate for a 'mascot as player sprite' pipeline.
score_hook: Each game already tracks a high score in localStorage; add a postMessage({type:'score'}) call at game-over (1-3 lines per game).
notes: Same author as LittleJS engine; 63 playable arcade games incl. many classics (pong, snake, breakout, tetris, flappy, minesweeper, 2048, missile command, plinko, slot). Has CLAUDE.md + templates/ folder. The single biggest ready-to-reskin corpus found.

name: KilledByAPixel/LittleJS
embed_notes: Engine is a single script (no deps); examples are plain index.html + game.js, run from GitHub Pages. Also ships vite-starter, typescript and module templates.
reskin_notes: Single 'tiles.png' spritesheet per game addressed by tile index (tile(index, size)); swap the PNG or the index and the player changes. Colors are Color objects in code. Trivial to parameterize via a JSON skin.
score_hook: No built-in; add postMessage in gameOver. Engine has no network layer, so bridge is pure JS.
notes: Tiny, fast, js13k-friendly; annual LittleJS jam produces many MIT games on itch. Pair with LittleJSArcade.

name: photonstorm/phaser3-examples
license: MIT (code only; ASSETS NOT licensed for commercial/ad-supported use)
embed_notes: public/src/games/* are single-file ES scripts loaded by the examples runner; each needs phaser.js + its assets copied out. No bundler.
reskin_notes: Phaser loader keys everything by string (this.load.image('player', url), load.atlas, load.spritesheet with frameWidth/Height). Reskin = swap file behind the key or point the key to the sponsor mascot sheet; a JSON manifest per skin maps keys->URLs. Warning: README says assets come from classic games/stock sites and 'cannot be used in commercial games or games that carry advertising' -> must replace art anyway (which you do for mascots).
score_hook: None; add window.parent.postMessage on game over.
notes: Biggest Phaser corpus (2000+ examples) but only ~15 are full mini-games. Phaser main repo phaserjs/phaser: 40.2k stars, MIT, pushed 2026-08-21.

name: phaserjs/template-vite
embed_notes: 25 official phaserjs/template-* repos (webpack 1173 stars, vite-ts 193, react-ts 200, nextjs 153, vue, svelte, solid, angular, bun, remix, tauri, esbuild, parcel, rollup, importmap, youtube-playables, twitch-extension, discord). All MIT, all refreshed Apr 2026. Vite build -> static dist/.
reskin_notes: Starter only (logo + scene). Preloader scene centralizes asset keys, which is the right place to inject a per-sponsor manifest.
score_hook: template-react/template-nextjs include an EventBus between Phaser and React - a ready-made pattern for a score bridge to a host page.
notes: Use as build scaffold for new games; not a game source. template-youtube-playables (15 stars) is a full sample game wired to an external portal SDK - closest analogue to what you are building.

name: EnclaveGames/Enclave-Phaser-Template
embed_notes: No build step: index.html + src/*.js + phaser.min.js; PWA (manifest, sw.js). Mobile-first HTML5 portal template by an Enclave Games (Mozilla/js13k) dev.
reskin_notes: img/, sfx/, fonts/ folders loaded in Preloader.js by key. Good screen flow skeleton.
score_hook: None built in.
notes: Check LICENSE.txt - it is CC BY-NC-SA, which blocks a monetized portal unless re-licensed. Structure is worth copying, code is not.

name: kaplayjs/kaplay
embed_notes: 126 example .js files in examples/ (each is a complete kaplay() program) + examples.json with categories basics/concepts/games. Runs from a single <script type=module> + sprites/ sounds/ fonts/ folders; no bundler needed. Kaboom (replit/kaboom, 2735 stars) is archived since 2024-08 - use KAPLAY.
reskin_notes: Best-in-class for mascot swap: loadSprite('bean','sprites/bean.png') / loadSpriteAtlas(json) / loadAseprite; every example uses the 'bean' mascot as the player. Replacing bean.png (or the atlas entry) with the sponsor's kitten swaps the player everywhere. Colors via rgb()/color() components. Examples are tiny (50-200 lines) so a codemod can inject skin JSON.
score_hook: None; add postMessage in go('lose') scene. remarkablegames/kaplay-template (MIT, Vite, 2026-08) is a clean build scaffold.
notes: Very active (pushed today). Examples site: play.kaplayjs.com. Game-like examples counted by name from the examples/ listing.

name: excaliburjs/Excalibur
embed_notes: Each sample is its own repo (excaliburjs/sample-*), TypeScript + Vite/webpack/parcel build -> static dist. 30+ sample-*/template-* repos, most BSD-2, several pushed Aug 2026.
reskin_notes: ImageSource + SpriteSheet.fromImageSource({grid:{rows,columns,spriteWidth,spriteHeight}}) and Animation.fromSpriteSheet; assets declared in one resources.ts and preloaded by a Loader. One-file swap per game.
score_hook: None; TS classes make adding a ScoreReporter trivial.
notes: Well-engineered, good docs, small but complete games (Excalibird=Flappy, Excalitris=Tetris, Jelly Jumper=polished platformer).

name: melonjs/examples
embed_notes: Each example folder has index.html + js/ + data/; runs from any static host (ES modules). Engine is a single ESM bundle.
reskin_notes: Manifest-driven loader (data/manifest.js array of {name,type,src}); TexturePacker/Aseprite atlas support built in; Tiled maps. Swap manifest entries per sponsor.
score_hook: None; add postMessage in game-over state.
notes: Only ~4 real games (platformer, space invaders, whack-a-mole, iso RPG). Mature engine, long-lived.

name: pixijs/open-games
embed_notes: Vite + AssetPack build per game -> static dist. Fully polished commercial-quality casual games released open source by the Pixi team.
reskin_notes: AssetPack pipeline (.assetpack.js) turns raw-assets/ folders into atlases + a manifest automatically; art lives in raw-assets/{bundle}/ so mascot swap = replace PNGs, rebuild. Themed via constants. Exactly the config-driven pipeline you want for two high-quality hyper-casual titles.
score_hook: None; game-over screens are discrete classes.
notes: Only two games but they are the most 'AddictingGames-grade' open-source casual titles found. Pixi itself is a renderer, not an engine.

name: GDevelopApp/GDevelop-examples
license: MIT (per GDevelop wiki: 'free examples are all MIT licensed' incl. resources; repo has no LICENSE file)
games: starting-* (60+ genre starters: flappy-bird, clicker, endless-runner, shootemup, vampire-survivor, card-game, quiz, platformer...)
embed_notes: Each example = one {name}.json + assets/ + README + preview.png. Needs an HTML5 export: GDevelop IDE (GUI) or headless via arthuro555/gdexporter (MIT, 28 stars, last push 2024-01) / GDevelop's own CLI in newIDE. Exported output is static JS+assets, iframe-friendly.
reskin_notes: Fully data-driven: project JSON lists objects with animations->directions->sprites->image file names, plus a resources[] table mapping resource names to files. Swap the file behind the 'Player' resource (same dimensions) or rewrite JSON with a script: no code. Engine also has a 'recolorizer'/'change-sprite-color' example and in-IDE 'quick customization' flow designed for exactly this reskin use-case. Team's asset-store art is CC0 (May 2025).
score_hook: Examples include leaderboards (GDevelop cloud leaderboards), leaderboards-firebase, newgrounds-api, crazygames-sdk-demo, facebook-instant-game; JavaScript events let you call window.parent.postMessage.
notes: Largest reskin-ready corpus: 288 examples, ~60 'starting-*' genre templates explicitly meant to be re-themed. Downside: build requires GDevelop toolchain (Electron/CLI) rather than a plain bundler; verify per-example asset licenses in each README.

name: godotengine/godot-demo-projects
embed_notes: Web builds of all 90+ demos auto-deployed to godotengine.github.io/godot-demo-projects (export_web.yml). Export needs Godot binary + web export templates; output is index.html + .wasm + .pck (~10-30MB). Threads build needs COOP/COEP headers on the portal (cross-origin isolation) - use the non-threaded export for iframe embedding.
reskin_notes: Sprites are .png in project folder referenced from .tscn/.tres files; swap same-name PNG + re-export. Heavier pipeline (editor/CLI export) and large payload vs. JS engines.
score_hook: JavaScriptBridge.eval('window.parent.postMessage(...)') from GDScript in web export.
notes: Great quality but only a handful are real games (Dodge the Creeps, Pong, platformers, RPG). Payload size and export toolchain make it a second-tier option for a hyper-casual portal.

name: defold/defold
license: Defold License 1.0 (Apache-2.0 derivative, source-available, free incl. commercial; NOASSERTION on GitHub)
embed_notes: HTML5 bundle via editor or `bob.jar` CLI -> static wasm/asm.js + archive; ~2-4MB. Defold has first-party portal extensions: extension-poki-sdk (37 stars), extension-crazygames (15), template-html5-poki, template-gamedistribution, sample-poki (pushed 2026-08-20), and indiesoftby/defold-yagames (75 stars, Yandex leaderboards).
reskin_notes: Atlas (.atlas) files list image paths; sprite components reference atlas + animation id. Swap PNGs in the atlas, rebuild with bob. Lua game logic.
score_hook: html5.run('window.parent.postMessage(...)') from Lua.
notes: Very portal-oriented engine (Poki/CrazyGames/Yandex extensions maintained by Defold Foundation). Samples are small; not a big game corpus.

name: HaxeFlixel/flixel-demos
engine: HaxeFlixel (HaxeFlixel/flixel 2197 stars, MIT) on OpenFL (openfl/openfl 2153 stars, MIT)
embed_notes: `lime build html5` per demo -> static export/html5/bin (JS, ~1-2MB). Requires Haxe + lime + openfl + flixel toolchain (can be dockerized). Demos site: haxeflixel.com/demos.
reskin_notes: assets/images/*.png embedded via AssetPaths macro; FlxSprite.loadGraphic(path,animated,w,h). Same-name PNG swap + rebuild. Haxe source means codemods are harder than JS.
score_hook: js.Browser.window.parent.postMessage() available on html5 target. FlxPongApi demo shows a score API integration (GameJolt/FlxGameJolt).
notes: ~14 real arcade games (Flixius shmup, FlxInvaders, FlxTeroids, Snake, Breakout, Flappybalt, MinimalistTD, Mode). OpenFL matters for porting old Flash games with source (AS3->Haxe is mechanical); openfl/openfl-samples (88 stars, MIT) are tech demos not games.

name: phoboslab/Impact
games: none bundled (lib + Weltmeister level editor only)
embed_notes: Plain script modules, no build. Classic 2010-era engine; commercial games (Biolab Disaster, X-Type) were NOT open-sourced.
reskin_notes: ig.AnimationSheet('media/player.png', w, h) per entity; swap the PNG.
score_hook: None.
notes: Verified MIT and open since 2021 but effectively unmaintained and no example games in repo. Skip unless porting an old Impact game.

name: craftyjs/Crafty
embed_notes: Single script; last push 2023-11 - dormant.
reskin_notes: Crafty.sprite(w,h,url,map) defines named sprite components; swappable but engine is stale.
score_hook: None.
notes: Dormant; not recommended.

name: ct-js/ct-js
games: bundled examples ship inside the desktop app (Platformer, Space Shooter, Jettycat, Catsweeper, Memory cards, Tanks) - not in repo tree
embed_notes: Export from the desktop editor -> static HTML5 folder. Examples live in the app bundle, not a browsable repo folder (contents/app/data/examples returned 404).
reskin_notes: Editor-managed texture/skeleton assets with JSON project file (ict); templates reference textures by name -> swap in editor or by editing project JSON.
score_hook: None; plain JS in scripts.
notes: Small community; GDevelop is the stronger no-code option.

name: cocos/cocos-engine
games: cocos-example-projects (580 stars): native-plugin, native-script-bridge, physics-3d, protobuf, occlusion-query - tech demos, no games; last push 2023-09
embed_notes: Web build via Creator editor; large runtime.
reskin_notes: Editor-managed SpriteFrame/AutoAtlas assets with .meta uuids - swapping requires editor or uuid-aware scripting.
score_hook: None; mstevens843/cocos-solana-mwa-sdk (2026-05) exists for Solana wallet in Cocos.
notes: Huge in Asia (WeChat mini-games) but its example repo is not a game corpus. Skip.

name: processing/p5.js + quinton-ashley/p5play
license: p5play Creator License (NOT OSI; free for individuals/education, commercial use requires a license) - p5.js itself is LGPL-2.1
embed_notes: Script tag; no build.
reskin_notes: sprite.addAni('name', 'file.png', frames) / addAnis; easy swaps but license blocks a monetized portal.
score_hook: None.
notes: Avoid p5play for commercial: custom non-OSI license. Vanilla p5.js (LGPL) games on GitHub exist but are student-grade.

name: straker/kontra
games: docs examples: galaxian, breakout, pong, tetris, snake (kontra docs site)
embed_notes: Single script or ESM; examples are inline on docs site. Hundreds of MIT js13k games use it.
reskin_notes: SpriteSheet({image, frameWidth, frameHeight, animations}); one object per game.
score_hook: None.
notes: Good for sub-100KB games; js13k catalog (js13kgames.com, mostly MIT) is a secondary corpus.

name: DarlesGames/darles-html5-multiplatform-template
embed_notes: Dependency-free shell (720x1280 portrait) with platform adapters in js/platform/adapters/ for Yandex Games, CrazyGames, GamePush, Playgama, self-hosted; handles pause/ads/auth/leaderboards/saves/localization/packaging.
reskin_notes: Wraps an existing game behind a scene facade; theming via CSS/config.
score_hook: Has a leaderboard abstraction layer across portal SDKs - useful reference for the portal side of a score bridge (adapter pattern: game calls platform.leaderboard.submit(score); adapter decides SDK vs postMessage).
notes: New (2026), zero stars, but directly models 'one game, many portals' - read for architecture.

name: playgama/bridge
embed_notes: Formerly instant-games-bridge. One JS SDK exposing player/auth, leaderboards, storage, ads, payments across Playgama, GameDistribution, CrazyGames (and historically Yandex, VK, Facebook, OK, etc.); Unity/Construct/GDevelop/Defold/Godot plugins.
score_hook: bridge.leaderboards.setScore / getEntries API surface is a good spec to mirror for your own portal SDK (games written against it can be pointed at your adapter).
notes: LGPL - fine to load as a script, be careful bundling.

name: Pelican-Party/adlad
embed_notes: Plugin-based abstraction over portal ad SDKs: CrazyGames, Poki, GameDistribution, GameMonetize, GamePix, CoolMathGames, Google Ad Placement, WGPlayground.
score_hook: No scores, but shows the exact plugin pattern (one interface, per-portal plugin) to copy for a 'PortalSDK' that a game bundles and your iframe host talks to via postMessage.

name: GameDistribution/GD-HTML5
embed_notes: Only major portal SDK that is fully open source on GitHub. Ads + game lifecycle events; the SDK inside the game iframe talks to the GD host page via postMessage - readable reference for a production-grade iframe bridge.
score_hook: No leaderboard API.

name: PsychoGoldfishNG/NewgroundsIO-JS
embed_notes: Official Newgrounds.io JS client (v3). ScoreBoard.postScore / Medal.unlock are 'secure' components: payload encrypted (AES-128/RC4) with an app encryption key embedded in the client, sent with a session id from Newgrounds login. Also official libs for Unity, Godot 4 (jefvel/newgrounds-godot-4, 29 stars), Haxe (Geokureli/Newgrounds, 51 stars), Kaboom (lajbel/newgrounds-boom).
score_hook: Best documented open score/medal API for embedded HTML5 games; note the client-held key is obfuscation, not security (see infra-notes).
notes: Older repo: PsychoGoldfishNG/newgrounds.io-for-javascript-html5 (10 stars, 2022).

name: DanielBakovic/MyArcadeScoreBridge
embed_notes: Tiny myarcadebridge.js: game calls myarcade_submit_score(score)/myarcade_submit_achievement(); bridge posts to the WordPress MyArcadePlugin host. The classic addictinggames-style arcade-portal score bridge (Flash-era lineage).
score_hook: Reference for the minimal API shape; trivially spoofable, which is why P2E needs server-side validation.

name: magicblock-labs/SOAR
embed_notes: Solana On-chain Achievements & Rankings: on-chain program + TS client for leaderboards, achievements, player profiles and automatic reward distribution; integrated in Solana.Unity-SDK. Exactly the 'score -> tokens' primitive.
score_hook: submitScore instruction; rewards (SPL tokens / NFTs) claimed on achievement. Score must be signed by the game's authority keypair (your server), so it is naturally server-authoritative.
notes: Not updated since Apr 2024 - treat as reference design; verify compiles against current Anchor before depending on it.

name: magicblock-labs/bolt
embed_notes: On-chain ECS framework for fully on-chain games + Ephemeral Rollups. Overkill for off-chain arcade games; relevant only if you want on-chain state.
score_hook: n/a
notes: MagicBlock org is the most active Solana-gaming org in 2026: Solana.Unity-SDK 197 stars (2026-08-19), magicblock-engine-examples 54 stars (2026-08-21; includes session-keys, spl-tokens, rewards-delegated-vrf, gachapon examples), session-keys (2026-05), magicblock-validator, ephemeral-rollups-sdk (2026-08-24).

name: magicblock-labs/session-keys
embed_notes: Session-key program (inherited from Gum, which shut down Sept 2023). Lets a game sign many small txs with a temporary key so players are not wallet-prompted per action - needed for frictionless reward claims.
score_hook: n/a
notes: Gum (gumhq/gpl 27 stars) is archived; MagicBlock maintains the successor.

name: solana-developers/solana-game-examples
games: solana-2048 (link: on-chain highscore with weekly resetting rewards)
embed_notes: Official Solana Foundation game examples; `npx create-solana-game` (solana-developers/create-solana-game, 2025-05) scaffolds Anchor program + JS + Unity clients. battle-coins shows minting SPL tokens to players from a program; solana-2048 shows highscore account + reward payouts (uses Gum session tokens, unaudited).
score_hook: Pattern to copy: score stored in a PDA by a program instruction signed by a server authority; rewards paid from a program-owned token vault.
notes: solana-game-preset (20 stars, 2025-03). Solana docs page lists SDKs: Unity (MagicBlock), Godot (Virus-Axel/godot-solana-sdk 78 stars MIT 2026-05), Phaser (Bread-Heads-Studios/solana-phaser-template 6 stars, 2024-12, no license), Turbo.computer, Honeycomb.

name: Bread-Heads-Studios/solana-phaser-template
embed_notes: Phaser inside Next.js with TipLink wallet connector; the one Phaser+Solana template linked from solana.com docs.
reskin_notes: Starter only.
score_hook: Wallet in host page, Phaser in canvas - same split you need (game iframe vs. wallet host).
notes: No license -> cannot legally reuse code; use as pattern only.

name: Honeycomb-Protocol (org)
license: mixed; SDKs unlicensed on GitHub (hpl-starter-kit 6 stars, Unity-SDK 0 stars, honeycomb-vue-example)
embed_notes: Hosted 'Edge' API + on-chain programs for profiles, missions, staking, resources/tokens; the on-chain programs themselves are not in public repos - it is a SaaS-style protocol with client SDKs (@honeycomb-protocol/edge-client on npm).
score_hook: Missions/rewards could map to P2E but you depend on their hosted Edge service.
notes: Low GitHub activity (last meaningful push mid-2025); many 2025 hackathon games reference it (Superteam bounties). Risky dependency vs. rolling your own SPL-token payout.

name: Udukuzi/nova-glitch-arcade-v1.1
embed_notes: Token-gated Web3 arcade with Solana integration - closest open-source analogue to the whole product, but zero stars and unverified quality.
score_hook: Leaderboard + token integration in app.
notes: Read for ideas only. Other 'web3 arcade' hits (candy-chain, luna-arcadia, PassChick) are 0-1 star hackathon projects on other chains.
